$comment: A battery-powered Tasmota sensor in deep sleep, over the hub's own MQTT broker (issue #72), run by the GENERIC mqtt adapter. It wakes every few minutes, reports, sleeps: the hub shows when it was last seen. Format: wiki Device-Templates.
name: Tasmota sensor (battery)
description: A battery-powered ESP running Tasmota in deep sleep (DeepSleepTime): it wakes, reports its sensor values and sleeps again. Temperature and humidity from the usual sensors (DS18B20, AM2301/DHT, SHT3x, BME280).

inputs.label: Topic
inputs.hint: A short name for the sensor's messages, e.g. garden_sensor (letters, digits, - and _)

steps.hint: Making the sensor's own login on the hub…

errors.timeout: The sensor hasn't connected to the hub yet. Check its MQTT settings, and that it's awake (it only connects every few minutes in deep sleep).
